blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Quirino Governor Dakila “Dax” Cua had been diagnosed with lung cancer as early as 2024, but he insisted on serving Quirino for another term, his father, Junie Cua, said before the House of Representatives. In his speech at the House’s necrological service for Dax, Junie, also a former governor of Quirino, said his son may have thought he was strong enough to take on the challenge of serving as governor since 2019 while also serving as president of the Union of Local Authorities of the Philippines (ULAP).
